__purpose: Player node: convert an incoming image url (including data URLs) into showImage/hideImage commands for routing to Client/Display sinks.
label: Image Player

metadata.description: Converts an image URL into showImage/hideImage commands for Client or Display sinks.

compatibility.rule: Connect cmd output to Display to route image commands to selected Display endpoints.
compatibility.repairHint: If the image is not visible on Display, confirm the Display node is connected and routed to the correct targets.

compatibility.rule: Connect cmd output to Client Executor to route image commands to audience clients.

repairHints: An empty image input emits hideImage.
